name: Spatio-Temporal Consistency Losses
definition: A set of losses ($L_{consist}$, $L_{id}$, $L_{bg}$) to ensure spatio-temporal consistency of synthetic faces over dynamic changes, preserving attributes, identity, and background.
summary: Spatio-Temporal Consistency Losses prevent flickering by enforcing invariance of identity and background attributes across different motions, distinct from temporal coherence or geometric flow methods.
